rules: Any liquid asset: stock, crypto, or leveraged/inverse ETF
Rotate each 6:30am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Leverage matched to conviction; asymmetric payoff preferred
Hard stop at entry; spot-crypto-only on weekends

positions.name: Solana
positions.catalyst: Weekend = spot crypto only (US equities/leveraged ETFs closed). Broad crypto relief bounce is underway: BTC has staged one of the fastest rallies of the year ($57,950 -> $64,474 in ~9 days) with spot-BTC-ETF inflows returning (+$132M on 7/18), reclaiming the $61-62k recovery threshold; all three majors are green day-over-day (BTC 64,474 / ETH 1,873.92 / SOL 76.11 live). SOL carries the freshest, most specific catalyst among majors: a Wall Street firm's Solana ETF-with-staking filing (7/16), plus Solana's June record $3.47B tokenized-equity trading volume and continued RWA-holder leadership; SBI Holdings expanded its Solana-Foundation-linked footprint (7/16 Coinhako majority stake). SOL live 76.11 (dashboard proxy asOf 2026-07-19T11:40:35Z, within minutes of runtime), up only ~+1.6% on the day — no chase.
positions.driver: Long the highest-conviction, highest-beta spot crypto as the relief bounce broadens. Asymmetry: SOL sits near multi-month lows (~$76, just off the high-$70s stabilization zone), so a large share of downside is already priced, while a concrete ETF-with-staking catalyst + RWA/tokenized-equity leadership narrative gives outsized upside if the BTC-led risk-on continues — SOL is the highest-beta major, so it delivers the most 24h upside on continuation. Spot (1x) is the only weekend vehicle and inherently caps downside vs weekday leveraged ETFs. F&G still 'Fear' (~27-31), which is exactly why 1x spot — not a leveraged crypto ETF — is the correct size even setting aside the weekend rule.
positions.risks: Fear tape persists (Crypto Fear&Greed ~27-31) and BTC faces a $65,500 resistance wall with cooling daily volume — a stall or profit-take drags high-beta SOL down hardest. Weekend crypto is thin-liquidity and gap-prone; a macro/regulatory headline can move it sharply with no equity hedge available. Idiosyncratic Solana network/outage risk. Hard stop 68.50 (-10% spot).
